name: chennai-metro-ridership-tracker
what_it_holds: MIT-licensed scripts building a time-series dataset of Chennai Metro ridership, explicitly modeled on the Bengaluru tracker; updated Sep 2026.
why_useful: Same India-metro pattern extended to a second city; low direct ABNB relevance.
themes: Public transit ridership and airport rail links (MTA, TfL, RATP, JR) as visitor proxies; ridership open data
why_all: Same India-metro pattern extended to a second city; low direct ABNB relevance.

name: RTD-gtfs-data
what_it_holds: Static GTFS feeds plus ridership-by-trip-and-stop data for Denver's RTD network, updated Nov 2025.
why_useful: Concrete example of an agency publishing GTFS-ride formatted ridership; low direct ABNB-city relevance (Denver not a panel city) but useful as a template/precedent for pulling similar feeds from NYC/other ABNB markets.
themes: Public transit ridership and airport rail links (MTA, TfL, RATP, JR) as visitor proxies; ridership open data
why_all: Concrete example of an agency publishing GTFS-ride formatted ridership; low direct ABNB-city relevance (Denver not a panel city) but useful as a template/precedent for pulling similar feeds from NYC/other ABNB markets.

name: MTA_Turnstile_Data
what_it_holds: Analysis repo (6 stars) working with raw MTA turnstile data; last touched 2024, appears to include some processed subsets.
why_useful: Minor alternative processing of the same MTA turnstile source; low incremental value over toddwschneider's repo.
themes: Public transit ridership and airport rail links (MTA, TfL, RATP, JR) as visitor proxies; ridership open data
why_all: Minor alternative processing of the same MTA turnstile source; low incremental value over toddwschneider's repo.

name: NYC-Subway-Frequencies
what_it_holds: Estimates NYC subway service frequency from the MTA GTFS static schedule and combines it with ridership data to estimate line-level ridership; updated May 2026.
why_useful: Line-level (rather than just station-level) ridership estimation for NYC subway, which could isolate airport-connector lines (A train to JFK, E/M to LaGuardia-adjacent transfers).
themes: Public transit ridership and airport rail links (MTA, TfL, RATP, JR) as visitor proxies; ridership open data
why_all: Line-level (rather than just station-level) ridership estimation for NYC subway, which could isolate airport-connector lines (A train to JFK, E/M to LaGuardia-adjacent transfers).

name: MTA_Ridership_Recovery_Analysis_Post_Pandemic_Trends
what_it_holds: 11-star analysis of MTA ridership recovery trends post-pandemic, updated Apr 2026; likely pulls MTA's public daily ridership dashboard data (subway/bus/bridges/tunnels) rather than committing a long raw panel.
why_useful: Points to MTA's own published daily systemwide ridership recovery series (subway, bus, LIRR, Metro-North, bridges/tunnels) which is a simpler, already-aggregated NYC visitor/commuter proxy than turnstile-level data.
themes: Public transit ridership and airport rail links (MTA, TfL, RATP, JR) as visitor proxies; ridership open data
